findings.summary: The path-traversal check uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator, so sibling directories like /cache/out_evil pass and members can be written outside the output directory; the same flawed check appears in the Rar (261), 7z (337) and tar (108) checks.

judge.reason: Identifies startswith(base) without trailing separator allowing sibling directories, same as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: If all members are blocked, the 7z targets list is empty and py7zr may treat an empty list as no filter, extracting everything including malicious entries; extraction should be skipped when targets is empty.

judge.reason: Speculative about py7zr treating an empty targets list as no filter; cannot verify from given info.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: Blocked members are only logged with logger.error and skipped, so extraction reports success with a partial result instead of raising an error.

judge.reason: Matches the known problem that bad members are only logged and skipped, yielding partial extraction.
